notes.title: Update 1.0.0.0
notes.content:
This update primarily focuses on migrating Capsa to a newer engine version and taking advantage of various features such as DirectX12.  This will bring considerable performance benefits to areas that were previously GPU bottlenecked.

In addition to these improvements, we've included several bug-fixes to various features and areas in the game. There are no notable new features or additions in this build as it is an update following up to our last major feature update which you can read about here.

Please note that this is a very large update (almost an entirely fresh download) because it’s been compiled in both a new engine and we've changed how the game is packaged. The benefit is that it will now take up half the disk space it did previously.

With this update we will also be leaving Early Access and entering Beta. We had originally planned to complete this during 2020, following on from our last update; however, a combination of Covid related delays and the fact we really wanted to include recent engine improvements meant we've had to delay things till now. There will, of course, be further updates, we are just moving to a different phase of development. In the short term we will be looking at updates to iron out any bugs that users report, which you can do so on the forums here.

Can follow on Twitter:
https://twitter.com/vetron

Patch Notes:

Customization
Fixed an issue with the right speaker not disappearing in some homes when selecting none.
Fixed an issue of some vinyl being present on floor when selecting none for floor items.
Fixed an issue that would allow some categories to be visible when they conflicted across homes and vehicles.
Fixed an issue relating to the cameras focusing on cushions with Tropical Cottage.
Fixed an issue with ‘Classic’ wallpapers incorrectly showing polka in the San Francisco House.
Fixed an issue with the San Francisco Large Item 1 interior having an incorrect camera.
Fixed various issues relating to dory internal customization.

General
Implemented DirectX12 RHI which will bring significant performance gains especially for areas that were previously GPU bottlenecked. 
Fixed spawns for slums and club escape in Cyberpunk region not being in the correct place.
Fixed issues with the Balloon Radial menu.
Fixed an issue where a vehicles engine would sound as turning off if the player left a vehicle having already turned the engine off. This occured after entering a vehicle for a second time after spawning one.

Environment
Fixed Grass in Homes on island north of Naupata
Fixed various terrain and foliage issues.
Fixed some torches having incorrect flames
Fixed some torches not aligned correctly
Fixed some San Francisco home types having claims in the wrong location.
Fixed an issue with barrel fires in the cyberpunk area of the map.
Fixed placement of various items around mataara.

notes.title: Update 0.14.0.0
notes.content:
This update is one of the largest we've done so far, and includes completely new character models, a brand new character editor, new vehicle type (balloons), performance improvements, additional areas (for cybercity), improvements to existing areas, better roads, various graphical improvements, ability to skydive and lots, lots more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/0e44a50530be17ba7df6b20ba4dbea51e9875ad1.jpg
Firstly we wanted to rework the characters to not only be higher quality, but more importantly support a wider array of clothing, hairs, and new headwear such as hats. There are now around 20 more hair options than there were for female for example, and a good number for the male character too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/b86102091b724304c0e552760584ce303c9ffeb5.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/76c5bd40bac749c73b12a85ff52a23732b368370.jpg
You can layer clothing so hoodies and jackets can go over the top of t-shirts, and various tops can go over the top of swimwear (you can visibly see the straps from the swimwear depending on whats covered). There are also variants for most clothing such as denim can come in full length, capris or shorts, some jackets can be armless and bikinis can have different styles of straps/ties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/7c10c2fee6a4f060619fede9e7ebe66301d4e9a8.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/ba3ff6265dd64c16324a5d96f080742f1d0df7f5.jpg
The editor itself now has its own background which you can change to view different lighting on the character as well as change pose making it easier for you to see what you are doing. The camera system has also been completely reworked for the character editor so can move around your character as you need.

Under options menu you can now preview emotes when you asign them to your favourite slots. As you hover over it will play the current animation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/f590f82a6da8e87a56cf712dbeed81f70e60797b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/0974600a3107729aef2eec9079629e5f1c7f2dba.jpg
There are now 20-30 more hair options which is a large increase in options over previous. In addition to this more than 2 thirds of these hairs will support hats including an altered wear style depending on how the hat sits.  By default a baseball cap and beanie are included free options, but more novelty hat options are included in a DLC we'll talk about later in these notes.  Several hairs also come with gradient options for addtional color customization.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/62420208d3357c8fdcf49690ef0e0ff506218f3d.jpg
Above you can see there is various makeup options for all the common things like blush, lipstick, eyeliner etc. Makeup is stored independent to your outfit, so you can switch outfits and makeups seperately rather than have to set it up for every combination. Outfits now have 32 save slots, and makup has 8 given you way more freedom to store multiple looks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/a3160869c1ffe4bb3ed3da146f1fa7df27200963.jpg
Our new vehicle type in this update is Hot Air Balloons which can be spawned at two locations (Mataara and Taipū). These balloons behave as balloons would and are not steerable per-se, but more controlled based on changing wind directions at various altitudes (In bottom right of your screen you'll see the wind direction indicator added to the compass, as you increase in altitude this will change and determine which direction you'll be taken).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/1f63c9199bfec5e6ab7e5b59986d8f131da37ee5.jpg
Once you've eventually reached your target with a balloon, we've added the ability to skydive and parachute. You'll need to have at least 50 meters relative altitude for skydiving to work, and ideally something like 80 meters to really slow your decent enough (else you'll enter rag-doll state when you land). The relative altitude means you can also attempt to base-jump from some hills or cliffs, and be able to parachute.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/b2a93be29e2aa0b0995b4e2d804a9e7da602f08f.jpg
Our Cybercity side-region has been expanded sligthly with the addtion of a new area, as well as an addtional club area so be sure to explore these new locations. Various graphical and lighting improvements have been done for existing areas too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/3959b5a7b4e0220fc55373546e03e5c2ad7401ec.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/89f24b97823ba8008a140e9ad0444180d79e8718.jpg
Roads have been improved with better road mesh, and signficiantly more detail along each route especialy in gaps between areas where previously wasn't much in the way of detail. Outer islands haven't been completed yet, expect this in a future update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/fbdd2bc0b8fa7180f7063b44b3217b59859fe6b3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/a29a6fb1788aecf940ae8554b28ef21e09db9406.jpg
Various existing areas have been given additional detail and filled out more. One example from images above is Wai Tai area, where additional islands, ship wrecks and a much more detailed dock area have been added. A rework of the roads in the vicinity has also been added to improve flow of driving through the area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/ce9bca9c128b45ad8457e5ff8114112180c18fae.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/f801c989b6cc83824fe5b475f98b677fb6ef7376.jpg
Next up we've spent a lot of time improving performance, especialy at key areas, and you'll notice that you should be getting higher fps in some areas where it would usualy dip.  For Ultra settings we've improved the shadow quality further, but if your fps does dip a little - reverting to 'High' for shadows, will be effectively what previous 'Ultra' shadows were. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/e0e40a059c098cb6f5f951164b056fb1f2857c43.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/815a378fe0049003ef0c902d5a6134f62e64aa07.jpg
In order to help fund development we've also released a new DLC called the "Year 4 Pass" which will introduce 2 additional boats, including a cabin cruiser with customizable interior, and also 1 additional variant of the balloon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1475340/Capsa__Year_4_Pass/
The DLC will also include 9 additional hat types (Propeller Cap, Sun Hat, Newsboy, Miner, Fedora, Derby, Cowboy, Panama, Santa Hat). 

Please let us know if you encouter any issues as we intend to do various hot-fix updates over the coming weeks. Our next major update will be in the New Year. 

You can join the Official Capsa Discord here:
https://discord.gg/6F8z83g

Plus can follow on Twitter:
https://twitter.com/vetron

Patch Notes:

Customization
Added many new hair styles specific for each genders of character as well as replace or rework previous popular styles with higher quality versions. Each hairs come with pattern options so you can do gradient highlights or split coloring per applicable hairs.
Added dozens of new clothing pieces specific for each clothing of character. Older clothing has been mostly replaced with newer versions.
Added ability to mouse drag rotate in character editor window when left or right button is held down.
Added ability to focus zoom in or out using mouse wheel up or down.
Added option to switch to different backgounds for characters so you can see how your outfit will look under different lighting conditions in the game.
Added a prompt to save changes when switching outfit slot in any editor after making a change. This will allow you to adjust and save multiple outfits without exiting the editor.
Added an improved prompt for pressing apply in any editor that will ask if want to apply and save changes.
Added Hot Air Balloon customization including at least 8 classic patterns for each balloon, with at least half being unique to each balloon type. Balloons will also accept neons as a customization option if you previously owned those or own the Standard Edition / Starter Pack.
Added improved footwear selection including new back-end systems to auto adjust the height of character to the ground depending on shoe depth and various overrides to tweak how animations are played with some shoe types.

Environment
Added improvements to some foliage rendering so it is always visible after first spawning with zero wait times. There are also significant improvements to game thread performance.
Added pivot interaction to most foliage, this means as a player or vehicle passes through grass or ground plants, they will be moved by the interaction.
Added new textures for palm trees.
Added performance optimizations to Mataara area on Metarahi.
Added improved shadow behavior for several buildings and the player character.
Added new roads visuals to replace previous which is now higher detailed, smoother and uses a more consistent width. Considerable map changes were made to accommodate this.
Added various small additions near Mataara area.
Added improvements to the shoreline effects under some lighting conditions.
Added improvements to caves so that you can see light outside the cave when near the exit. A few specific locations may still use the old method due to limitations of the geometry in those spots.
Added LOD and culling improvements to various distant meshes like windmills and docks so they can visible in a better state from a distance.
Added water fluid motion effect when you swim.
Added improvements to the Race Track area at Hianga.
Added improvements to south Pekanga Gas Station.
Added improvements to the road between Hianga and Pitonga.
Added significant rework to Wai Tai area.
Added improvements to performance in Rohai area.

General	
Added ‘drivable’ Hot Air Balloons, these behave as a real world balloon would and you have no control over steering them, just ability to control their rise and decent. A wind system has been introduced based on how it would expect to function in the southern hemisphere where this game is set. Specifically as you gain altitude in a balloon the wind direction will be clockwise, and that’s how you travel in different directions. Everyone will get one Hot Air Balloon for free, with all options available to customize and a second balloon type will be part of the new DLC.
Added ability to skydive including full parachute customization. To skydive simply jump from a location with a height over 50 meters relative to your velocity. E.g. if you jump from a hill your forward velocity will give you a jump arc of over 50 meters in lots of cases despite the slope of the hill putting you near ground level at the start of your jump, thus you can enter a sky dive state.
Added improvements to all sitting animations for aim offset, now specifically only the neck/head will move and so the remainder of the animation should behave correctly.
Added improvements to horse moving animations, with head turn based on the movement direction.
Added various improvements to dance animations, firstly a frame reduction has been performed to give performance gains particularly when you had a really crowded dance club. Secondly Food IK has been added which means feet will remain on the floor, the behavior Capsa already used for all general locomotion.
Added improvements to character editor behavior so you can continue ground sitting or dancing when entering the editor.
Added improvements to vehicle spawning behavior. Vehicles will now sense ground or water height and be placed within half a meter of its surface so will spawn smoothly. For boats especially this means they will no longer appear to drop from a height simply due to placement at some docks.
Added spawn effects for both vehicle and characters so they will appear to blend in using a reverse dissolving effect. This only happens for the first spawn, so for a character getting out of a vehicle does not re-run the effect.
Added improvements to foot ik’s to account for problematic surfaces like plank walkways and docks.
Added new sitting, dancing and gesture animations as well as improving the quality of all previous animations.
Added a rework of Ladders to improve the animations and reliability.
Added various improvements to climbing holds.
Added a rework of swimming animations and behavior.


Downloadable Content

Added new Year 4 Pass DLC that inlcudes 3 additional vehicle, pulse neons and 9 hats.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/885bcf1624e2904a5697ad39f8a67c83302d2bf5.jpg
Over the past week or so you’ve likely seen posts from other developers outlining their current situation in relation to COVID-19 pandemic. 

Firstly, the team is currently safe and in good health, but we are expecting some disruption to usual development hours potentially in the short term. The game server we host, and general function of the game will however be unaffected as these use 3rd party / off-site services and in the short term these providers have stated they do not believe there will be any disruption.

Given we know a lot more people are going to be at home we have decided to reduce prices on most Capsa DLC’s for the week by 50%, this will of course exclude our recent releases. So, if you are new to Capsa and don’t yet have the standard edition or simply want to support us then now is a great time to purchase.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/976050/Capsa__Starter_Pack/
As always if you encounter a bug or issue with the game, then please post in the bug-reports discussions forum so we may address it. Our next major update is already underway with us expecting to have it released sometime in mid-May. We’ll be covering what this update entails in future posts over the coming weeks.

Stay safe and thank you for your ongoing support.

You can join the Official Capsa Discord here:

notes.title: Update 0.13.0.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/f9f57b05d5d446045612153826f40c5005549b96.jpg
For Caspa 0.13 we've added various quality of life improvements to the race and customization systems, as well as environmental improvements to the sky and select areas.

There has also been a long list of bug-fixes to reported issues over the past couple of months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/546ee3860d7d28abe7eb88ac4a82dbfe1cd428a1.png
Improved Sky and Day CycleAs part of this update we've overhauled the Sky considerably with several new features and additions. Firstly there are now 3D volumetric clouds that are fully dynamic with server synced density changes, which make the sky much nicer to look at. These are controlled via the Effects quality option, with them only being enabled in medium to ultra, with various quality/density changes as level increases. For most users low amounts to give a good background ambience should have little performance impact. In the photo mode the density can be adjusted in real time to get even better screenshots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/b31fbc2ebd9b944a75388706fca76696117bdb16.png
At sunset you'll find a more orange and vivid sky that reacts great with these new clouds but this is not where the new features stop. After sunset we come to the considerable improvements to the night sky which now includes real time, accurate, 3D stars based on a database of information. This will allow you to see the night sky as you would be seeing it at that very moment if you were to be on the loosely based on french polynesian island in the south pacific. Capsa's stars also move based on your position and this is a feature we will be using later on as the world expands, but for now in the real world you can pretty much use the Latitude and Longitude of -16.499701, -151.770538 if you want to compare to online star mapping tools. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/e746481ed731d9d4e99fa62605c5245904552b17.jpg
In addition to stars you'll also be able to see planets you would normally be able to see with the naked eye so something to look out for! Because not everyone knows the night sky off-by-heart and even less so for a distant south pacific island; we've added the ability to highlight in real-time the constellations in the night sky. By default this is achieved through holding the N key, but can be changed in options too. Upon holding this key all 88 constellations including all stars that comprise them will be highlighted. But do bare in mind this is a South Pacific island so you'll only see the stars as from that perspective and not all will be above the horizon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/931e92310ad9089e3f331a644c06f77856ed3d43.jpg
Improved Customization BehaviourOne of things we've added is making it easier to apply paint jobs to vehicles across all parts. Going-forward you will now be able to set the pattern on the 'Body' of a vehicle and it will be automatically matched up and carried over to other parts such as different hoods, spoilers and side skirts. 

Another change we've made is that when you switch through parts and items, not just for vehicles is that the customization system will now try and match up the current pattern and variant with the next item you pick. For instance, if you wanted a painted version of a vehicle rim, and switch through the list you will see a painted version until you switch the variant. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1246740/Capsa__Fire__Lightning_Patterns_Pack/
We've also released a new paint job pack which works for all vehicles. These are the Fire and Lightning patterns that were for some vehicles and previously sold separately or as part of the Vehicle Novelty Patterns pack for a while, if you owned either of those then you'll get every one of these new paints as a free update to those. For the Fire pattern specifically we've developed a version that allows you to color tint in addition to the natural look.

Over time we hope to look at other previously individual patterns and update more of them to work across all vehicles.

Home additionsFor homes we've added the ability to have a pair of arm-chairs instead of a sofa with most sofas having a matching themed chair equivalent. Each of these chairs, like sofas, can optionally have a cushion added that can make use of various patterns including the novelty or flag ones (if you've bought either of these DLC packs for character then most of these work as a free update on cushions). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/e437b3fac8bec979665093d5499793fc2c5ee1c9.png
Also for homes we've added optional Coffee Tables in a range of matching styles to existing furniture which can support at least 6 small items on them. The above picture is from the Retro home items pack which has been expanded as part of this update, items such as flowers, books and candles are included by default with more to be added over time.

On some tables as well as some existing side tables you can now choose to place some books or a selection of vinyl on the lower shelf as well.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249250/Capsa__Retro_Home_Items_Pack
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249251/Capsa__Contemporary_Home_Items_Pack/
Lots of additional furniture has been included in this update both free and as part of DLC. We are re-releasing two prior home item packs the Retro, and Contemporary (previously just named Modern). These re-releases are free updates to anyone who owns these packs from some point before separately or from the Home Essentials pack that was sold for a while so you do not need to purchase them if that is the case. Additional home items have been added to the Starter Packs as well as a free update. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/d63942fa4e9f345cce9c67306d2c9d7132458f3f.jpg
Engine Sounds & Additional Optional Vehicle ControlsWe have fresh engine sounds to fit with the different engine types for most boats, with the current outboard type remaining the same. These sounds will also bring unique start-up and shutdown sounds as-well. This update introduces sounds for the Outboard types (Mako / Moray) and the old engine types such as the Junker.  The barrelback has yet to be completed and will come as part of a future update.

In addition to these sounds we've added the ability to manually shut-down and start-up the engine on all vehicles. For users who wish for their engines to start automatically, as before then they simply have to hold accelerate for a second and it will automatically start. For races and first spawns the engines will auto-start.

Another change is to make headlights more useful by increasing the range and brightness levels of default, this should make it easier to see in night races or driving around in general at night.

There is also a way to manually control your headlights, which can be enabled in the game options (otherwise behaviour  remains automatic). This allows you to turn your headlights on or off at any time, with them automatically being turned off when the engine is off. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/ab63fbf81c977f9fb743f0bd461220eff82b6684.png
Improved Roads and Area UpdatesSomething we've been working on is overhauling the roads and overall road-side detail, starting with the main island of Mataara. This includes markings, signage as well as things like the occasional pot-hole or roadworks detailing. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/08d8fd28ae527f73ee41e6c92bcd64b8ea43fe37.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/cfc2f16370bc15f06fd8e76c52e9ca9ca0b6d936.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/a3eb72fffaa3443749752ebd691f10b27ae1e75f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/7c01d64087b33ce0c4d117cca439097c81fc7d95.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/a9ea1eda2eb62053a1f4ec1cfa7d3696205eb372.jpg
Some areas like Kataara, Mataara and Moka have been targeted this update for quality of life  improvements to bring them up to par with more recent areas. Mataara in particular you will find things like a functioning door on the gas station shop, moving windmill with ambient sounds, as well as additional ambient sound volumes for things like the gas station air-con unit. Mostly little things but helps improve the ambience as a whole when visiting these locations. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/8a4b5badee158d12b5ab3612f4c390b88d87f8ca.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/45f54bf0c04333ad21294f011850dcc5808cfe6c.jpg
We've worked on the race track area to bring it up to par with added detailing such as tirewalls, track graffiti and improved landscaping. This track now features as a circuit race as part of the event system.

The races as a whole have had various improvements, notably circuit races will now track per-lap timings and show you your best lap time. This time is what is stored on leaderboards.

Other Changes and Bug-FixesIn addition to all these changes are a long list of bug-fixes and quality of life improvements which can be found in the full patch notes below. If you encounter any problems do let us know so these can be targeted with a fix for a future update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/63acb36b8235df11019e20e4fbdb2913cfd08356.jpgOne change we've made as part of this update is implement the bare-bones of a progression system which handles the unlocking of vehicle parts (and eventually other things). This can really only be found by looking under the statistics menu right now, but as it gets developed there will be a lot more to this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/42a559719f1fe7b3bee4f1f650d597094f04ad79.jpgThe way it works in principle is essentially earning points for progress towards specific things such as say completing races, locating hidden items or driving distance in a specific vehicle, this all accumulates and determines your overall level. Currently there is only 10 levels, and not all of these grant a reward so is still bare bones and will be going more into this over future updates as it progresses.  

You can join the Official Capsa Discord here:
https://discord.gg/6F8z83g

Plus can follow on Twitter:
https://twitter.com/vetron

Patch Notes:
Customization
Added improvements to the way ‘Variants’ are handled, now Metal and Painted versions of items can now be variants with dynamic hiding of not-needed color options with the intent of making the lists tidier.
Added improvements to the way items are switched in the list, it will now try to match the current variant, pattern category, pattern and color preset with the next item if that variant is available and unlocked.
Added additional versions of the Large and Small Globe to homes. Requires owning the Starter Pack.
Added armchair pairs as additional seating option instead of sofas, with versions of existing sofa’s where they exist in real life.
Added additional home items to complete furniture sets. Some items have been replaced or tweaked to maintain consistent styling of a set.
Added popcorn and cherry bowls to go in some inside and outside slots.
Added new Hi-Fi system with multiple variations to go in home media slot.
Fixed incorrect materials for some home floor options.
Fixed an instance where engine customization wouldn’t apply correctly.

Environment
Added start of roads overhaul with markings and various added detail.
Added improvements to Katara, with emphasis being around home areas.
Added improvements to Moka area including path detail and rework.
Added transitions between day and night for some ambient sounds.
Added improvements to tunnel transitions near Mataara so will continue to see light at end of the tunnel in most cases.
Added improvements to the road between Mataara and Katara adding additional detail such as fences, trees and buildings along the route.
Added improvements to bird emitters so only visible at suitable times of day.
Added three-dimensional volumetric clouds including density variation to the dynamic night/day cycle. This will be visible on high through ultra effects scalability levels.
Added accurate stars (and planets) for night sky including realistic positioning based on in-game location. Each star is represented based on extensive data including spectral type data. 
(An improved Aurora Australis has been added however this will be visible in locations during a future update.)
Added shooting stars to look out for in the night sky.
Fixed LOD’s on some rocks and other various environment pieces that were a little close.
Fixed footsteps not triggering on some foundation wall pieces.

General

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
We have a major update currently in the works which we intend to release sometime in the next couple of weeks or so, this will bring improvements as well as some new features. We'll detail a few things we are currently working on as well as discuss some of the recent changes we've made to our store packages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/d63942fa4e9f345cce9c67306d2c9d7132458f3f.jpg
Engine Sounds & Additional Optional Vehicle ControlsWe have fresh engine sounds to fit with the different engine types for boats, with the current outboard type remaining the same. These sounds will also bring unique start-up and shutdown sounds as-well.

In addition to these sounds we are adding the ability to manually shut-down and start-up the engine on all vehicles. For users who wish for their engines to start automatically, as before then they simply have to hold accelerate for a second and it will automatically start. For races and first spawns the engines will auto-start.

Another change we are adding is to make headlights more useful by increasing the range and brightness levels of default, this should make it easier to see in night races or driving around in general at night.

There will also be an option to manually control your headlights, which can be enabled in the game options (otherwise behavior remains automatic). This allows you to turn your headlights on or off at any time, with them automatically being turned off when the engine is off. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/931e92310ad9089e3f331a644c06f77856ed3d43.jpg
Improved Customization BehaviorOne of things we are looking at is making it easier to apply paint jobs to vehicles across all parts. Going-forward you will now be able to set the pattern on the 'Body' of a vehicle and it will be automatically matched up and carried over to other parts such as different hoods, spoilers and side skirts. 

Another change we've made is that when you switch through parts and items, not just for vehicles is that the customization system will now try and match up the current pattern and variant with the next item you pick. For instance, if you wanted a painted version of a vehicle rim, and switch through the list you will see a painted version until you switch the variant. We are looking at expanding this to color presets as well, so you can preview paint jobs for vehicles very easily as you go through the list.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/ab63fbf81c977f9fb743f0bd461220eff82b6684.png
Improved RoadsSomething we've been working on is overhauling the roads and overall road-side detail, starting with the main island of Mataara. This includes markings, signage as well as things like the occasional pot-hole or roadworks detailing. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/08d8fd28ae527f73ee41e6c92bcd64b8ea43fe37.jpg
Some areas have also recieved considerably more detail such as this waterfront area in Mataara shown above. Here can serve as a good vehicle meet-up spot, and also has access to a boat dock on the shoreline.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/8a4b5badee158d12b5ab3612f4c390b88d87f8ca.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/45f54bf0c04333ad21294f011850dcc5808cfe6c.jpg
We've worked on the race track area to bring it up to par with added detailing such as tirewalls, track graffiti and improved landscaping. We intend to have this track now feature in the race events system. We want to look at adding further races as well to add extended variety to the already 20 or so races in the system.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/976050/Capsa__Starter_Pack/
Store ChangesWe are changing the line-up of packages we have for sale in the Steam Store. This is from a point of view of trying to make things clearer and more attractive to purchase and we’ll detail what these changes are.

We now have a ‘Capsa Standard Edition’ which is basically just the normal free to play game plus the starter pack most of you will have already bought already. It will be the same price as the Starter Pack individually, and there is zero different between already having the starter pack DLC separate or even continuing to buy the DLC separate, its just a way to make stand out what is the core package for the game on the main page.

What is included in the starter pack is changing, but before we go into details of what these changes are, we will say that anyone who purchased previously won’t loose anything, and new stuff you’ll automatically have access too as-well. 

The main changes are that we are now including additional items for the Homes that were previously sold separately, as well as all essential customization for the pets such as all the base fur patterns for Cats.  The price has also been dropped going forwards.

Users who purchased Capsa before it was free-to-play have essentially a copy of the Starter Pack so will continue to gain anything the Starter Pack gains.  

Second to this is we are also combining the pattern packs to be around theme, and not character type. An example of this is where previously we had novelty pattern packs for Pets and Character, we are going to combine this going forwards, and add support for things like the home sofa pillows and some compatible vehicle hoods.

The Vehicle Novelty Patterns pack will be divided up into smaller packages around specific paint job themes, with the first being “Fire and Lightning”. The difference here is that these will work with every vehicle going forwards and have a significantly lower price per paint job type. Anyone who bought the pack previously will not lose out and will receive these individual packs as they are released.

Vehicle kits are being removed from sale, and we plan on implementing a form of progression system that hasn’t had all its details worked out yet to obtain these going forwards. Anyone who bought the packages already will continue to have these parts unlocked. The main driving force here is that we want to make things straighter forward on what you need to buy and can buy. 

The Home Essentials DLC comprises of several home kits, not all of which will not be transferred to the Starter Pack and will be released separately. Examples of these will be the Retro and Modern kits. As with other packs, if you bought this combined package you will just get the individual as they are released. 

We hope to have new releases out for the re-arranged and divided up packags likely to coincide with our next update, which we hope to have finished in the next two or so weeks and will have more information on those then.

https://discord.gg/6F8z83g

Plus can follow on Twitter:
https://twitter.com/vetron

For this update we've expanded on the homes system to allow much wider customization. This includes the ability to set up the garden area for homes, as well as introduces an a new home type. There are also many new items to customize both inside and out of all homes.

notes.title: Update 0.12.6.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/16b6f29ad52c8270563e3bb9a36fab07c12432a2.jpg
This update includes an area expansion to the outer island of Tautini, it also introduces significant load time reductions.

The new area is reachable by heading north from Kapiti or boating across from Hianga. It includes an inland waterway with a swamp like area that goes into a river. Connected to this area to the west are other work in progress areas which will be finished in future updates. Below are screenshots from this new area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/0ce1fe3877abafc95e61dd49e3e81ae60895afec.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/cb0e8bcb6624b5ff7659ec91ac4f4e5769c86984.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/5fa3416763d0cb64e0eff5ec56d824dbb6b014de.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/07311a1ac2c15b0f62a00a50d4aa853132f6a97d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/f729969797c1cfc0bc24aa6d5e55c724c7ee17e9.jpg

In addition to the new area is optimizations to the loading times through changing how the game is packaged. We've tested our changes on a range of hardware, including some low-end SSDs, and various old disk based drives. For a low-end SSD that would load the game in around 4 minutes previously, this has been brought down to around 30 seconds, and an old disk based hard drive that took 6 minutes, is now able to load in just over a minute.

Faster more typical SSD's useful for gaming worked out between 20 and 30 seconds. M.2. drives were also tested, but these were already pretty quick before the changes, but on different hardware loading times was brought down to between 10 and 20 seconds. 

These times are for first time extended loads or after a major update. In order to undertake these changes a one-time large update was required to restructure game files (why this update is just over 2gb in size compared to our regular size ones).

For this update we've focused on improving the boats, this includes giving them improved wake visuals, adding in over 40 different patterns for customization, as well as a few functional additions such as optional locked throttle and ability to toggle fenders or bimini if equipped.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/63580542d570c357d1c6651cec13f89db7e813a1.jpg

NOTE: Wake effects will change depending on graphics setting set, shown above is as it would look in Ultra. In High they are similar just reduced in amount, and in Medium/Low these effects are disabled.

Below are screenshots showing a selection of the more than 40 new included patterns for boats (each boat has at least eight new pattern options in a catagory labled 'Classic'). Each of the boats in these screenshots is using a color preset for its main pattern (so you can easily have your boat looking like any of these if you wanted), but they can each be color customized freely to your personal taste. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/f0fb0a0a52d9b54c01089527dc405ee814b97d31.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/1e4570fbadaf2c891596076ca82a79f6e0030dbc.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/0c421d2c076441f9754fd6a0da6b615d4f11df1b.jpg

Above is a rounded Barracuda hull which is free, and a different front for the Moray (railing was seperated from the previous middle part so have an option to work with some patterns) is part of a DLC pack. When enabled when you release the throttle/move forwards button the boat will not throttle down and you’ll have to manually move down using the reverse key. For usability sake, when the throttle is <10% in either forwards or reverse it will still throttle down to 0. By default C key will switch throttle type.
Added improved first person camera for boats where the players head/hair will now be hidden so you can look around easier.
Added adjustments to boat propeller spin rates at low throttles to have a faster rate.
Added key to toggle hiding of fenders if equipped to a boat. By default, this is X key and labeled as ‘hide/show accessory 2’ in control options under ground vehicle. Additionally, when you respawn a boat or open the customization menu these will be visible again. 
Added key to toggle Bimini (open/closed) if equipped to a boat. By default this is Z key and labeled as ‘hide/show accessory 1’. The default appearance of the bimini will depend on whether you have picked an open or closed bimini in the customization menu as per normal. It will revert to this every time a new boat is spawned.
Added slightly larger radio range for boats as well as a longer fall off when is a media stream in slots mode.
Added camera adjustment for the Moray to make it easier to see in First Person (raised camera height slightly).
Added change to Event Invitations, these will now only occur when players are currently actively playing. E.g. when a player has manually joined, other players will then get invited.
Added new spawn menu images for some boats using new patterns.
Fixed a collision issue with front of Barrelback.
Fixed walk toggle for character initially taking two presses to enter walking.
Fixed boat x and y angles resetting during photo mode (they should now freeze in place at instance of entering photo mode).
Fixed camera position for Moray Steering Wheel in the Customization Editor.
Fixed an issue where switching between Steering Wheel and Front in customization editor wouldn’t correctly change camera.
Fixed an issue where a vehicle spawn menu could say an area name for a few milliseconds during opening.
	
Downloadable Content
Added Vehicle Novelty Patterns DLC which will include all previous vehicle patterns included on the item store.	
Added Flames Barrelback Pattern to Vehicle Novelty Patterns DLC.
Added Camo Barrelback Pattern to Vehicle Novelty Patterns DLC.
Added Lightning Pontoon Pattern to Vehicle Novelty Patterns DLC.
Added Flowers Pontoon Pattern to Vehicle Novelty Patterns DLC.
Added Lightning Moray Pattern to Vehicle Novelty Patterns DLC.
Added Flowers Moray Pattern to Vehicle Novelty Patterns DLC.
Added Flame Mako Pattern to Vehicle Novelty Patterns DLC.
Added Camo Barracuda Pattern to Vehicle Novelty Patterns DLC.
Added Surf Rescue Pattern to Vehicle Novelty Patterns DLC.

notes.title: Update 0.12.0.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/8e09ed21c302c705b3e528802b95c9cb0fb427c8.jpg
Update 0.12 has been released and is one of the largest updates to Capsa so far. It introduces online multiplayer racing through a new event system, adds several improvements to existing areas, and features an overhaul of ground vehicle item drops.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/c2fb825249d9b0a3deb50b1f365e8466c8969642.jpg
The new online multiplayer racing events each consist of 5 stages. Each stage is a different circuit or checkpoint race that’s randomly selected from a pool of 18 different courses with various modifiers such as course direction. Throughout the event players will accumulate points towards a different level of rarity of item drop that’s rewarded after the final stage. 

    {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/1879ecace9e94e312f26b70c4df1525db2b384e4.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/2ae21717f93db48d4d9a339e41b24b55857f0ac5.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/5faa1882655f2305e108489cdc4ac5524d2576ce.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/3237bfbf509c4e444535148cc638ae3c6a7d81b9.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/98c2a48754e97076795897e1bb5ad263aa5801fd.jpg
To join an event, you can either accept one of the given invitations or through the radial menu manually select to join or put yourself in queue for the next event. Players can join mid event on e.g. stage 2 of 5 if needed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/c5ad79530a5a77c11554abafc2a272d7c6089e51.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/aaaf7c4fc987e1e47f65a56225568a9e9964f160.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/f44b9ca91bc6b85bbea4b9504c3c5b00f2d05ae0.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/44f1348eb50f241357410d2199c25911437217f1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/eb44edde202e7765d5611fb71fc0d0577d707eda.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/c39ebfc013c9ea23ae7a916fd5224a85d21ff770.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/0357e1988045425d3fca5ca8af759d6a1f2e8417.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/c64cd3df83b4a02e59900518d68a0160637eaddb.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/db3d769516c2076d6423917995309047f6369dbf.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/4be975244773d88cc255094bf2b350de1e1f4536.png
Item drops have been significantly reworked in this update, including the addition of several hundred new items that can drop. These can only be obtained through the racing events, as well as hidden locked boxes as before. There is no limit on how many item drops you can earn through events each day, with each event typically lasting between 20-30 minutes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/33643e6cf8fe602216603d8e32dd30aa407b73e3.jpg
To use the dropped items there is a new ground vehicle engine editor, which can be accessed via 2 key or via the radial menu when sat in a buggy. This system provides you with 8 engine slots, and you can switch engine slot independently to your currently chosen buggy; which means you can reuse the same engine across all your vehicles if you wish. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/7abf0c27ec77ff5a672615cb2e22c7f4a3ecbe54.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/a3eb9afabc01eb2b12dc4743879ff693346bd731.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/f7e17b6075a72be430f4cc3eeb254481b8a7d75f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/8f4017eabe0cb31ea11ec5015076e704b1de86bf.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/d7a73ee3646f02650b43c735d6b17a26b8874c39.png
This new editor also allows you to mix some vehicle parts together, so lets say you have a legendary carbon muffler but would prefer the silver bits to be gold; well, now if you have a different metal variant of the same part type you will automatically be presented with additional variants.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/e7b41937fb7854a9701c6968d97fe34b11262c3b.jpg
Other changes in this update include additions to several areas, as well as updated spawn menu images for most locations. Loading has also been improved so it will be slightly quicker for most users (5-10 seconds less) but more imporantly it now shows the loading percentage for the individual map tile step, allowing you to see the real loading progress.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/977170/Capsa__Vehicle_Raider_Pack/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1003681/Capsa__Vehicle_Race_Pack/
In the past week we've also improved the above DLC packages, which now include a few more items each as well as better promo images. In addition to this, some parts have also recieved additional pattern options and nearly every vehicle customization item has recieved color presets so you can get ideas and a start point for how you want your vehicle to look. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30701603/23cd8551abc029afea86ecf5b6bfc54548269325.jpg
But this update isn't all vehicle themed, you'll find a new Bar in the Mataara area which features functional bar stools. The existing bar has been updated to also feature fully functional seating. In addition to this work-in-progress seating has been added to the dock near the creek in Mataara and Pond at Rohai, this allows you to sit on cushions with your feet over the edge.

Other noteworthy changes include time of day cycle when changing via command, this means for users on high graphics settings users will see the time of day move quickly to the changed time over a few seconds rather than instantly snap.  Also added is improved responsiveness for lighting changes after leaving caves, and toggling the hide/show hud option; both of which should be fairly instantanious now.

There are many more additions in this update listed in the full patch notes below.

You can join the Official Capsa Discord here:
https://discord.gg/6F8z83g

Plus can follow on Twitter:
https://twitter.com/vetron

Patch Notes:
Customization
Added up to 9 color presets for all ground vehicle parts and patterns that use the same colors as the parts used on some engine item drops.
Added an additional side option for the Enforcer Buggy as part of same kit as the other side panels. The pattern has also been tweaked slightly on some side parts to give a more consistent look  with color presets.
Added stripes pattern for Dragonfly Buggy.
Added split pattern for Dragonfly Buggy including matching pattern for various parts such as roof and side panels.
Added new simple pattern for Dragonfly Buggy including matching pattern for the roof part.
Added split pattern for Victor buggy including matching pattern for side panels, hood and spoilers.
Added new simple pattern for Victor buggy as well as a new simple pattern for parts such as the side scoops and spoiler.
Added stripe pattern for Victor Buggy.
Added partial unpainted metal option for Victor Buggy.
Added split pattern for the Scorpion buggy.
Added stripes pattern for the Scorpion buggy.
Added matching simple to the tarp and spoiler of the Scorpion Buggy to match the hood pattern.
Added matching flames to the tarp and spoiler of the Scorpion Buggy to match the hood pattern.
Added split pattern for Enforcer Buggy including matching pattern for various parts like the roof,  sides, bumpers and grills.
Added new simple pattern for the Enforcer buggy roof, grills and bumpers to match the hood.
Added gold and silver metal variants for all buggy Rims.
Added new simple pattern and base material for all shocks allowing more customization.
Fixed an issue with base textures of the Dragonfly buggy.
Fixed inconsistent material on Victor Hoods.
Fixed scorpion bar covers split pattern being inconsistent to other split patterns (was wrong way round).
Fixed an inconsistency where the Scoprion had a different stripe pattern, this has been set as the simple instead on the Hood.
Fixed some missing bars on the Enforcer Buggy under some configurations.
Fixed an issue where one rim of Classic Rims 2 wouldn’t color correctly.
Fixed a lod issue with the Enforcer Hood that was visibly changed a little too close.
Fixed an issue with normals at the rear of the Enforcer Buggy.
Fixed Barracuda Fenders not receiving color customization.
Fixed Barracuda Gauge metal being incorrect material.
Fixed various text strings for Barracuda customization options.


Environment
Added rework of some parts near Paka to support races.
Added improved behavior to time of day changes via command with a blend between the times rather than an instant switch. 
Added rework to a section of Rohai where there is a section you drive through a beached shipwreck, this has been reworked to be more reliable for driving through with racing.
Added rework to a section south of Paka to aid with flow of racing by adding an additional cut-through and smoothing out of some of the dunes to be less bumpy in spots.
Added additional shoreline detail to Hianga area to improve the flow of racing.
Added reworked race course to Hianga, the dirt section inside the concrete circuit loop.
Added new cave section to replace the previous cave that was at Pekanga. This new section allows vehicles to drive through.
Added improvements to the beach race track at Taipu, this involves adding additional or wider run-off area following large jumps, as well as adding a north entrance.
Added a new tunnel and changed the layout of some roads near Taipu.
Added a layout change to the roads near the slums area, now you will flow up the main street in and out of the slums, rather than have to take a detour if just passing through. Secondary roads that previously detoured have been removed (this new route is actually quicker to drive through lets you pass through a detailed area).
Added new dirt road between Taipu spawn area and the Slums area.
Added improvements to dirt road that climbs the hills near Kura.
Added new race course area near the Junk Yard at Matira.
Added through road at the south end of the Kura track.
Added various quality of life improvements to Kura area, notably reworking rock section near the graveyard.
Added reworked motel to better fit with the rest of the surrounding area theme.
Added a new open bar area at Mataara with nearby parking are and vehicle spawn, this is just down the road from the initial spawn, the other side of the rock arch.
Added significant area expansion to Hianga, including a new construction site area, with vehicle jumps and area to explore.
Added improvements to the race course at the Logging Camp area, with additional fences, grass placement, and general tidy ups to make the races flow better here.
Added improvements to various ponds and streams with added aquatic plants.
Added significant improvements to tunnel in Mataara area.
Added lamp posts between Mataara and Hianga.
Added improvements to cave volumes so glow in the dark and emissive elements are more responsive to being updated.
Added a performance optimization that will reduce cpu usage when foliage is set to low, when using a low end machine.
Added a rework of the Paka container yard area, making it useful for a circuit race and generally improving the overall detail of the area.
Added rework of the handling of ambient volumes, now when a player respawns in areas with a different audio set a second layer of checks are performed to ensure the correct sound set is played. This was notable if for example teleporting between Mataara and Taheke or similar, where uncommon sounds are in use such as the frogs by the water. 
Added some improvements to Whakarua area by improving some of the roads nearby, and moving the spawn location.
Added a change to the ‘Item Store’ building in Mataara to rename it ‘Showroom’.
Added some cushions and blankets to various locations for sitting on the edge of things, such as rusty beams or docks – more will be added over time.
Added various additional detail to the dock on the creek at Mataara.
Added some rocks to occlude in the Mataara area to provide better performance.
Added various optimizations to landscape materials around Mataara area.
Added various performance optimizations to forest foliage, including culling and shadow usage.
Added additional horse spawn at the bottom of the stone steps in Pekanga.
Fixed some floating torches in Kura area.
Fixed some floating props at a Pekanga Gas Station.
Fixed mods on various décor assets such as walls and fences.
Fixed placement of some torches at Arohata.
Fixed cave and mine audio reverb.
Fixed LODs on a Wooden Cable Reel that was a little close.
Fixed placement of some rocks in the cave section at Whare Witi.
Fixed some prop placement (crystals and some rocks) at the cave at Kura.
Fixed a gap in the sidewall at the church at Kura.
Fixed a few seams in the foundations at Wai Tai docks and Lighthouse.
Fixed some assets at Mataara lacking correct physical material to produce relevant footstep sounds.
Fixed some objects placement at Mataara.
Fixed culling distances of the fences at the Beach race track in Taipu that were a little too close.
Fixed a seam in the roof of Hianga car park.
Fixed placement of various torches at Whare Whiti and Matairangi.
Fixed distance shadows on some cave and tunnels not working correctly.
Fixed some terrain smoothing at Kauanga and Whakatupu.
Fixed some torch placement at Kopia.
Fixed various issues relating to some torches not relighting after being knocked down in caves.
Fixed a duplicate crash barrier in Rohai area.
Fixed render distance of some rocks, bridges and other landmarks that were culled a little too close.
Fixed various prop placement at Mataara.
Fixed LODs on some garbage bags that were a little close.
Fixed some props accepting decals when they shouldn’t in the hianga area.
Fixed culling on some docks and roofs around the Kura area that was a little close.
Fixed a cave in Taipu that didn’t didn’t correctly transition lighting when entered.


General	
Added new Ground Vehicle engine editor menu, this separates out editing of the engine components from the rest of the vehicle. 
Added additional cameras for editing Ground Vehicle engine.
Added improvements to ground vehicle third person camera. Camera will now reset within a second when it is moved and the vehicle is in motion. When stationary the camera will not automatically reset position.
Added bumper camera to ground vehicle. This is a static camera on the lower front of the vehicle that has no part of its view obstructed.
Added improved responsiveness for player names during hide / show HUD events.
Added additional menu to the radial menu to cancel event invitations as well as join an event currently in progress manually.
Added functional bar stools and booth seats to Skywatchers bar.
Added auto-hiding of players head, hair and headwear when in first person mode and driving a ground vehicle.
Added new spawn menu images for several areas.
Added a performance optimization that will shut down some foliage rendering updates when the player is stationary (e.g. at a cinema).
Added additional key inputs for changing chat tab.
Added change to vehicle part item drops, these are now obtained from completing race events.
Added improvements to loading screens, the current package progress is now shown (so you’ll know how far into loading e.g. Tropical_x2_y1 you are), as well as the game being less hitchy overall during this process. Loading times should be reduced slightly.
Added improved back-end unlock handling, checks will also be performed on first load of the saves and will auto-correct the saves prior to hitting any editor to revert any locked content to the preset. Example of this being selling or trading an item drop you had equipped.
Added change to vehicle radial menu to support additional engine menu for ground vehicles.
Added achievements for Events, for completing an Event, as well as completing 25, 50 and 100 events.
Added achievements for the Ground Vehicle Engine Editor.
Added titles for new achievements.
Fixed some hidden item placements in Matairangi and Kauanga.
Fixed Sea Horse achievement.
Fixed entering a cave or tunnel area, the area name widget would not update correctly.
Fixed a physics issue with boats and jumping behavior.
Fixed an inconsistency issue relating to the Public Server list default padding.
Fixed various achievements relating to emotes, ground sitting and dances.
Fixed an issue where setting first person camera when driving a buggy would not persist when respawning the vehicle.
Fixed an issue where the wrong chat icon would show next to the chat buttons. This now updates between action sets.
Fixed the rewind feature not handling area volumes correctly.
Fixed sitting in a chair not showing the correct status.
Fixed instances where a Speed Trap would only trigger once for a player during a session.	

Item Store / Downloadable Content
Added a new rim type to the Vehicle Essentials DLC.
Added Character Camo patterns to the Character Novelty Patterns DLC.
Added overhaul of Item Store to remove all items that have been added to DLC packs over the past year or so or will be released as such in the coming month. The item store will instead be used to promote new vehicle paint jobs. 
Added more variants of the Bull Horns and Skulls Hood Ornaments to the Vehicle Raider Pack DLC.
Added Crosshair and Dead Face Hood Ornament to Vehicle Raider Pack DLC.
Added Horse War Mask to Vehicle Raider Pack DLC.
Added various improvements to the Vehicle Raider Pack DLC store page including new promo images to better show what the pack contains.
Added Horse Race Kit to the Vehicle Racing Kit DLC.
Added Horse Glow Kit to the Vehicle Essentials DLC.
Added Horse Unicorn Attachment and Venetian Mask to the Starter Pack DLC.
Added various improvements to the Pet Essentials DLC Store page including new promo image and updated description to show added Calico and Tortoiseshell Patterns that were added a few months back.
Added various improvements to the Vehicle Race Pack DLC, including new promo images for most kits, including added horse race kit.


Item Drops
	Added ability for some vehicle parts to be combined to give additional combinations. An example of this is you can take the Gold Air Filter 2 with Black Filter, and mix it with the Silver Air Filter 2 with Purple Filter, and be able to have a Gold Air Filter with Purple Filter. This works automatically and as you choose variants and pattern options for some parts, more options will be presented as you own a combination of different items (this is logical such as with the air filter example above).
Added several hundred new Ground Vehicle Engine item drops, including new legendries and new part types.

notes.title: Update 0.11.9.0

notes.title: Update 0.11.0.0
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/6b2b271dbd4a0c535bd52d0cc5910980b3606bee.jpg
This is our version 0.11.0.0 release and consists of a huge update to various elements of the game. Notably including brand new media queue / playlist for cinemas, considerable improvements to homes, Mataara area expansion featuring new cinema, brand new HUD elements for vehicles, and physical gauges on all water vehicles.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/39031af6992d7d00ea4337ca665bc0f0d4190008.jpg
The most notable feature in this update is the media queue, shown above; this allows all players to contribute to a playlist which will then be cycled through. This currently works with YouTube videos. Its possible to vote to skip on submissions, as well as use share links with start time specified. 

This media queue feature can be found at cinemas, homes and vehicles, with players able to set permissions on things they own (homes, vehicles etc.) to be steam friends only if they so wish. Cinemas are always set to public and no longer need claiming, simply walk up and press Q or select from the radial actions menu to open the media queue menu. For Homes and vehicles, players will need to set to "Queue" mode instead of "Slots", from the customization menu under options (where you usually set media to play etc.).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/75d4409b409cc2261f90202ecaaa7a0692637090.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/13c185d99e0dfe82aa5c0e96fcab75b0c3e244c8.jpg
To go together with the new media queue system addition, we’ve considerably improved the current homes with lots of new items, patterns and options. Shown above is how two default homes now look. For first time users when they claim a home for the first-time, they will be automatically given this customization by default to their initial save game. Existing home item packs have been updated with new additions, and we are working towards bringing out a combined DLC for all these item packs likely next week.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/eb51f51589e738ef743182d9bc54376bbf9afc02.jpg
Next major addition is the vehicle orientated HUDs, this means vehicles now use a much easier to read ribbon compass and have on-screen speedometers (tachometer with digital speed output). Some vehicles such as boats also have physical gauges added to their dashboards which will be expanded to more vehicles across future updates. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/49cba50c74786c986ae8f249c046d2007657f96a.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/171b335da7a1cc6d7345d8ef14d384a0c6481716.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/e0f15ce7e2c2e9e86aab284ecf6603b9353d7bf8.jpg

notes.title: Update 0.10.30.0
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/7b613029f4d988a3851ad7f589c70add1c083871.jpg
This update introduces two new features, a vehicle selection menu for use during vehicle spawning, and secondly a photo mode. We’ve also added a new motorboat, the Moray which has been added into the Capsa Starter DLC which all owners of (plus all owners of the game when it was sold) will get as a free update. It can also be purchased individually from the item store.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/f3c8584daff8e6ab4c7d5d16b5a35c85caf35b2d.jpg
To get the vehicle selection screen, simply walk into a Ground Vehicle or Water Vehicle spawner as before and instead of spawning your chosen vehicle that you’ve set in the character editor, you will instead be presented with a new selection menu screen and can choose easily from there. When a vehicle is spawned you can still change it via the character editor as before and it will respawn. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/ea99cda2ff52055201b2b279e740b079ce6a2626.jpg
Second is the Photo Mode, via pressing the hotkey (P by default) you can artificially freeze your character and parts of the world. In the included menu when in this mode you can adjust your camera, tweak the focus (Bokeh Depth of Field), and adjust environment settings (such as time of day, bloom, lens flares). As Capsa is a multiplayer game this obviously does not freeze the entire game as that’s not practical, what it does is freeze other people's characters and vehicles from your perspective, meaning they are still moving around and doing things, you just don’t see it while everything is paused. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/22babe1645cb5ee0adcddbe9002f8d48a33efb75.jpg
A useful part of this, for example, is if you are standing on another players party boat and wish to take a screenshot, the world and your character will freeze in position but only from your perspective. This means, when you exit the photo mode you are still standing on that boat, wherever it may have travelled to when you were paused and not something silly like throw you off into the water at the position you paused.

Beyond all these changes we've also included fixes to various reported issues found in full notes below. As this is a major update we'll likely be following up with a hotfix or two over coming days to any issues reported.

Patch Notes:
	
Environment

Added improvements to the way the time of day updates via manual command, so it can effectically make changes in real time rather than a fraction to a second or so delay.
Fixed culling of some wooden platforms including docks being a little too close. 

General	

Added vehicle choice menus for both Ground Vehicle and Water Vehicle spawning. 
Added photo mode (activatable via P key via default) that freezes the action and lets you adjust your camera, focus and environment settings to get a better screenshot.
Added general improvements to the replication of waves. 
Added general improvements to the horse, utilizing some of the back end locomotion improvements previously done to the main character.
Added speedometer and tachometer, currently only on Moray motorboat for now. 
Fixed an issue relating to boats not moving with waves over network when you are no longer in the boat.
Fixed an issue with the cat hats when cat is sitting on shoulder of a boat driver.
Fixed an issue where you couldn’t hear other boat users engine sounds correctly.
Fixed an issue where title wouldn’t show for passengers under various circumstances.
Fixed a minor animation issue where the rider doesn’t remain aligned correctly when starting moving on a horse.
Fixed an issue with swimming animations not handling speed.
Fixed an issue where camera state was not persisting to main character.
Fixed an issue where a driver would still be seen in a boat from the perspective of the player who has joined after the owner of the boat has dismounted.
	
Item Store
Added Moray motorboat,  this will be added to the Capsa Starter Pack DLC. Users who already own this DLC will receive this vehicle as a free update.
Added Moray motorboat Bimini kit and Race kit, these will both end up in either the Bimini DLC or Race DLC, and users will also get this as a free update.

notes.content:

This update is all about new character locomotion and various quality of life improvements to some interaction elements. This means most of the characters animations and movement has been reworked. These changes come with new modes of movement such as crouching, plus the ability to enter a ragdoll state when falling from a height. There is also more fluid animation changes on existing grounded movement states. 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1697037141 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1697037966 A further change is that all the Radial menu’s (for vehicles too) have been replaced with more quality menu’s and all outstanding issues with them being fixed. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/96511fbe71c6e76e42a92efd6a2ca27de47f0986.jpg

Notably as a result of some of these changes we’ve reworked how dances and ground sits are handled. Now these all fall under a single category of “Emotes” and you can pick 5 of the various subtypes that you can pin to the radial menu and newly added hotkeys (6-0) to trigger each. These can be changed in the Character customization menu under options tab.  The reason for these changes as it frees up UI space and simplifies the triggering of them, it also allows us to add more to the game where there wouldn’t have previously been the UI space to select them (theres two new dances added in this update, but stay tuned for additional emotes being added over future updates and general improvements to the handling of this).

notes.title: Update 0.10.20.0
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/706ac1595aebdb8e23af16bf4c55806ff36c6ec2.jpg
This update includes several significant improvements to the game as well as some new features. One new feature is the addition of a new hidden item type that makes use of picklock gameplay as well as doors you need to picklock in your quest for hidden items.

Among the improvements, we now track both first person and 'game mode' mouse movement more globally in the game, plus have a default preference option. Going forwards 'game mode' will be enabled by default, but can be easily changed under Camera options, under Game in Options menu.

A second really important improvement is that we've overhauled the tracking of stats and achievements so they should be firing instantaneously when you collect an item while less important stats, such as distance, will update every 2 minutes. These can also be checked in the updated statistics menu in game too.

Other improvements include an overhaul of the 'Rewind' function for vehicles and characters, for aiding when getting stuck. This feature now only tracks the 3 seconds of rewind ability vs velocity, so being stuck in one place, motionless, means you will have a virtually infinite window to press the rewind button (F4 by default). 

Additionally, we've done significant performance optimizations which reduced the game's installation size by over 2 gigabytes. This will have a positive effect on memory usage and loading times.

Below are some pictures of some area changes we've made, there are lots of other additions in this update.

North Arohata on Naupata

Added improvements to the default preset for the Barracuda boat, the initial configuration looks better as seen by new players.
	
Environment

Added improvements to several areas on both Kiokio and Naupata. Notable areas with significant improvements are Kutekute, Huna, Wapu and Arohata. Various other areas have minor additions.
Added improvements to collisions of rope bridges, horses should traverse them now without issue.
Added various additional fish and turtles near Wapu.

General	
 
Added camera option to options menu to set whether ‘game mode’ is enabled by default when you first play the game. Going forwards it will be enabled by default, the hotkey remains to allow you to toggle ingame too.
Added camera option to options menu so you can set whether the game will start up in first person by default, by default this is disabled.
Added improved handling of achievements and stats. Achievements such as items and areas should appear now within seconds of obtaining, with stats being updated every 2 minutes generally. There are also on-screen notifications when finding areas now.
