notes.title: Update 0.10.0.0
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/305139a7ddc0ea191acb0f4da48703aeaf8938ca.jpg
This update brings a significant rework to the homes and clubs, plus introduces a bunch of new drivable vehicles. 

A significant change to how homes work is that ownership will now be persistent, per server, based on various factors saved after the player logs off. These factors focus on a player’s overall play time, meaning that someone who has only played the game for a few hours will still “unclaim” virtually instantaneously, as before when they leave. Players who’ve played tens, hundreds, or thousands of hours will see their house remain for an extended period before they are unclaimed. 

On the vehicle front we’ve introduced 2 new drivable boats and 2 new buggy's, with the new boats being considerably larger than our previous offerings. These new boats are each capable of carrying a large group of people around. The pontoon boat in particular has an open deck design so you have room to dance, essentially giving you a moving dance club. The vehicles, as a whole, will now be able to play music. Dances have been tweaked so they will work on a moving vehicle.

There are many more changes and additions in this update, which can be found in the patch notes below. Be sure to check out the item store for all the new vehicle kits and accessories added in this update.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/6433b927584377fa88a2576fa8ec7525be6bb3f6.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/ed7cb4c7e48cfbe39d98e2a16e969e38db46729b.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/08bfc79ef545f5a2d2b16bb2c35fbc63d79afbcb.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/72fe9ecac985f1323cbd3f4c683328c15077ff08.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/90dc179114602bb5c5f95653b0c54bb6eb7ded6c.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/faf8a0ab0fe4b44dae177d60c106bb02d928108f.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/86c4d65a3ca45df38fb525844416b43c226dde0e.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/c5083c8771bc1aa918408978436cfbdd7e821a33.png

Patch Notes:

Customization

Added rework of all buggy frame materials, including various quality improvements as well as a new paint look. Previous paint variant options have been removed.
Added improvements to the Raptor buggy: the hood is now a separate, customizable piece in the editor (under “front”). This is a step towards hood kit modifications for this vehicle.
Added Shorts for female character.
Added Lacework Camisole and Crop Top variants. These use a new unique simple pattern due to the difference in material detail.
Added rework to improve the quality of the perforated Camisole variant.
Added Hood Ornaments slot to ground vehicles. Hood Ornaments can be found in the item store.
Added “Front”, “Back”, “Top”, and “Sides” slots to ground vehicles. These will be utilized for various vehicle kits found in the item store.
Fixed issues relating to alpha on male and female flippers.

Environment

Added improvements to interior lighting, so things like the ceilings of homes do not have such dark shading.
Added additional homes, pathways, and general improvements to Katara area including secondary boat docks to serve houses.
Added additional homes and general improvements to Hianga. 
Added a rework of a road near the Mataara motel so players can reach the vehicle jump from both directions. The blue water tower has been removed, but detail has been added along the road. 
Added new docks and paths to Pitonga area.
Added revisions to ramps at Rohai to make them easier to drive up.
Added revisions to main jump ramp at Hianga to make it easier to drive up.
Added additional dirt between the motel at Mataara and a dirt road next to the nearby race course.
Added a new spawn area for Whakaoma.
Fixed an issue relating to the size of area volumes near Pitonga.
Fixed part of a chainlink fence post that didn’t have correct material.
Fixed placement of various foliage and props around Mataara.
Fixed lighting at the club at Mataara, adding a bit more light in places where the dance area was pretty dark at night near the front.
Fixed a tunnel that had minor rock clipping through one point.
Fixed culling distances on lamps in Mataara tunnel.
Fixed culling distances on various street clutter.
Fixed some road decals spilling over onto vehicles.
Fixed some unsmooth roads near Hianga.
Fixed beach area smoothness near Pitonga.


General

Added Pontoon party boat. This open-deck boat features room for dancing on.
Added Mako deck boat, a large motorboat featuring a pair of sofa-like seats, and other chairs to let you transport yourself and up to 7 friends as passengers. 
Added Enforcer buggy, a 2 seater which is slightly smaller than existing buggies. 
Added Dragonfly buggy, another 2 seater using the new shorter frame length type.
Added reworked selection of homes, now featuring outside areas. Each house includes a patio and garden area.
Added new camps. These temporarily claimed locations feature a place you can, sit, dance, and customize.
Added improved support for playing YouTube videos. Media interface will now accept any YouTube url. Limitations still exist in the form of restrictions beyond our control e.g. region, or restrictions on embedding/mobile. 
Added persistent homes system, so houses will now persist as a player’s sole possession for a measured amount of time (based on a player’s playtime) when they leave a server. This does not apply to clubs or the new camps.
Playing 24 hours will equal a 3-day window, 100 hours will equal 7 days, 1000 hours 14 days, and 2000 hours will equal 28 days. Given there is a finite number of homes on the Capsa map, this feature is designed for players with considerable playtime who frequently return in mind. Any new player who plays for an hour or so and leaves will have their home “unclaim” virtually right away. There is a 30-minute window added so players don’t lose their stuff if they need to restart or disconnect. As before, the home data is saved and if the player has to reclaim a home, or wants to choose another, all the customization is carried across.
Added revised sit animations, with improved blending between poses.
Added improvements to ground sit handling, so when a player sits on a moving vehicle, e.g. a boat, they can inherit the rotation and location of the boat, and travel with it.
Added revised dance animations, with improved blending when switching dances. Most of these have been adjusted to be better suited within confined spaces, e.g. dancing on boats.
Added considerable texture memory optimizations, which will also reduce installation by around 5 GB. 
Added changes to how connection and spawning is handled, players will now connect to a server first and then select where to spawn. This is to allow the player to locate their claims on the server and be able to choose to spawn at their home for example. 
Added improvements to the mounting of vehicles, particularly boats. The range will now extend further down below the boat to aid people who had issue transitioning from swimming to the boat previously.
Added improvements to how players interact with vehicles or things to sit on. This now scans the world around the player at point of interaction, rather than previously relying on collision. This rules out any inconsistencies as a result of latency.
Added music players to all ground and water vehicles. Primarily this was done so players can now have their own party boats, especially with the larger boats we’ve added such as the Pontoon boat on which players can dance on its open deck, even while it’s in motion.
Added various performance optimizations relating to the LODs of all previous boats.
Added additional hull type for the Barracuda motorboat, featuring a different rear cone
Added a key to prevent camera resetting while it is held down, useful for taking screenshots.
Added a key to reset the camera immediately when pressed.
Added keys to select your next and previous media slots, as well as disable.
Added keys to control media volume and mute it.
Added chat media channel which will output information when using the keys to change volume or current media slot.
Added color preset system to all customization editors, this allows players to pick (where applicable and available) a preset color selection for the current pattern. players can then override these colors, so it can be a convenient start point to making their own customizations.
Added smoother vehicle replication, this will make the experience as a passenger of a vehicle under typical network conditions more fluid.
Added a send button to the chat window, this will behave identically to pressing enter in the chat.
Added animation improvements to the chat window to better fit elements.
Added chat tabs to the chat window, for now these are for default (everything), and a tab for local only (omits global chat).
Added item store promotion to loading screen, we’ll use this to show some featured and new items (because some users were unaware of new stuff or the item store’s existence).
Added improvements to server configuration, notably so that the country code which displays a flag on server list menu is obtained automatically.
Added updated steam controller configuration to feature various new functions such as the ability to quick reset camera.
Added various changes to existing achievements, firstly some home achievements and achievements relating to the cinema have been removed. This is because they are no longer relevant. The tiles will be available still, just on different achievements. Editor ‘time’ achievements have also been removed, and have instead been changed to be apply customization a number of times.
Added achievement for dancing with a crab.
Added improved dirt detail to the default buggy rims.
Fixed an issue when switching clothing in the character editor where pattern selection index was not reset to reflect newly picked clothing piece.
Fixed an issue when pressing enter to enter chat and using mouse to click exit and getting stuck in a menu state until pressing enter again.
Fixed an issue where initial chat box was limited to the size of a message and could only be clicked on 2/3rds of it to enter the chat.
Fixed an issue with area volumes not being handled correctly, particularly the south end of Metarahi where there was a chance of receiving duplicate enter messages in chat.
Fixed an issue relating to how data tables are handled for mounts, which on rare occasion could result in loading the incorrect entry via combo boxes. This is now aligned with all other vehicle types. 
Fixed an issue where when respawning a notification of the area you were entering wasn’t always displayed.
Fixed an issue where compass would move erratically while dancing.
Fixed an issue where “/me” didn’t appear to be replicating messages correctly.
Fixed an issue where dancing time wasn’t counting towards achievements.
Fixed an issue where sitting and editor time wasn’t counting towards achievements. 


Item Store

Added T-Top kit for Barracuda motor boat.
Added additional parts to the Barracuda Bimini Kit.
Added additional parts to the Barracuda Race Kit.
Added Performance kit for the Barrelback motor boat.
Added Race kit for the Barrelback motor boat.
Added Sundeck kit for the Barrelback motor boat.

Added Steering Wheel Bundle 3.

Added flame paint for the Pontoon motor boat.
Added Raider Kit for the Enforcer buggy.
Added Race Kit for the Victor buggy.
Added selection of hood ornaments for ground vehicles.

notes.title: Update 0.9.3.0
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/0c2cc18257d5a45fb2ed8a99574633303efb4c08.jpg
This update adds significant improvements to the ocean water in preparation for future drivable watercraft update. There is also improved transition when entering and exiting the water. 

We have also improved the switching between graphics quality levels, plus increasing the detail in some elements in lower settings (particularly in caves) so there is consistently no difference in what you can see. Another addition is cinematic quality graphics options, which are basically settings we deemed too costly performance wise to be suitable for Ultra. These are in their own section, and there is no overall cinematic quality setting to avoid anyone mistakenly enabling. 

Patch Notes:

Environment

Added more consistent materials for foliage allowing effects quality level to be switched smoothly at runtime without foliage disappearing.
Added changes to the cloud density changes, this is to reduce overcasts and more commonly produce lighter varied clouds.
Added Ti-Plants to foliage density scaling, which should help draw in low/medium graphics settings.
Added performance optimization to low quality shadow setting by removing the directional sunlight. Instead this relies on an increased skylight, which also helps stopping the scene looking so washed out without the presence of shadows.
Added performance optimization to turn off parts of the ocean water material when entering caves.
Added improved water material with planar reflections present in high and ultra.
Added improved water transitions (from/to underwater etc.) to be smoother and more reliable. 
Fixed issue of shininess of some leaves. 
Fixed issue with fire particles not rendering correctly outside ultra/high.
Fixed some terrain painting issues around waters near Kiokio.
Fixed some water-height issues around Rohai. 
Fixed incorrectly placed trees on Naupata.
Fixed an issue with ambient occlusion masking some emissive objects for some users.


General

Added some minor improvements to address an issue where character could still be seen in a vehicle when getting out on rare occasion.
Added various performance optimizations to reduce level loading times.
Added cinematic graphics option section, these are very performance demanding settings, that were deemed too expensive to be included as part of ultra. Primarily useful for taking screenshots.
Added cinematic graphics option to enable advanced scene capture for planar reflections (primarily effects the ocean, means you see landscape and objects in reflections, by default you just see the sky)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/5b4b88bacb6994b5c894b59248ba7c646e49add2.png
This week’s major update includes the first implementation of pets, with pet crabs now available. Current implementation includes the pets either following you around, sitting or riding on your shoulder, as-well as full customization. In order to get a pet you need to open the character editor, then on Options Tab there is a section called "Pets" where you can switch between "No Pet" and "Crab". 
Please remember this is still an Alpha, and given this is a major update, there will likely be issues relating to the pets, so please let us know of any issues you encounter, and we can get them fixed as soon as possible over the coming days. In future updates cats and other animals will be introduced as pets, plus the ability to name them.

Another addition is we’ve optimized the character applier and save system by removing some structures in a move for greater standardization, specifically we no longer keep hair data separate to clothing, and use single functions throughout to handle it. You will need to repick your hairstyle after this change as it will have been lost, all other outfits and clothing will not be affected. This was part of our development towards pets.

Other performance optimizations include repacking of textures on some clothing accessories to save both texture memory and disk space. We’ve also at the same time improved height detail in the materials so you should see notable improvements with more pronounced hems and perforated clothing.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/1de4c3b1bf7e9cc96daf63f81ce204e548a51bdc.jpg
We’ve migrated the game to the newest version of the Unreal Engine with this update (4.19 from 4.18), plus included a bunch of media improvements. Please let us know if you experience any issues with this update :)

Specifically for media playback we’ve added a secondary decoder, which upon the standard framework failing to load a video, which it does with some formats, it will pass the video over this and attempt to load it there instead. This will mean some videos that might not have played previously will now play.

 Patch Notes:

Environment

Fixed collisions on large telescope arrays and propane tanks.
Fixed various terrain painting on Kiokio.
Fixed various torch placement on Kiokio.

General

Added unreal engine migration to 4.19 from 4.18.
Added improved codec support for media playback, so will play even more formats.  This will continue to use the existing player where media will play, but upon failure to load it will then attempt to load with a secondary player. 
Added improvements to some cinema screens, they will now project in real time the light of what’s playing on the screen onto the ground and area. This will be tweaked over future updates.
Added support for temporal upscaling, this will present a sharper image when employing a lower resolution scale (Slightly sharper image using lower graphics settings, essentially. If you want a few extra fps, set your resolution scale to around 90% and it will look pretty close, but give you better performance).
Added various adjustments to low quality graphics settings. Now has less foliage, but better tonemapping.
Fixed an issue with the Cinema screen placement on Naupata.

notes.title: Update 0.8.11.0
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/e5b499fac09b6b64e91bc0c667b05751f3692999.jpgThis major update includes a new area based around a large telescope array and observatory. Inside the main observatory structure is one of our new features, a 360 cinema. From here you can immerse yourself in almost total 360 video surroundings. 

In addition to this new cinema type, we’ve also overhauled existing cinemas with a new approach to displaying in-game videos. Previously we would only support youtube, and had a cut-down web-browser to render them. This wasn’t particularly good, as it lacked audio control, and was limited to really that one provider, which didn’t always work anyway. With this new approach we do not support any specific provider directly, but instead accept any direct media url to be played by using the same system to would already power the audio output in our club areas. This also comes with the benefit of better video quality, better audio quality, audio volume control and fading of audio as you move away from the area. It also will mean pretty much no hitches, and better fps in general. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/bacaa0ee846487d4829f067a87d6ef19d46c7dce.pngSecondly in this update we’ve also introduced support for the Steamworks Inventory Service, which allows us to better manage items in the game. This means items unlocked through gameplay, or purchased via DLC will be handled through this system instead. In terms of how the game operates, nothing will really change front end, you will customize characters as. The only visual change you will notice, is your items are now stored under your Steam profile Inventory (which can globally be made private or friends only if you need to for whatever reason).

In addition to this inventory support we’ve also created an item store on steam. This will allow us to release items more easily than the conventional DLC method (and not wait on approval before a product is sold). We will be aiming to remove all existing DLC packages from sale, sometime over the next week or so and instead focus primarily on this item store. You can visit the item store here.

 Patch Notes:

Environment
Added new area to Metarahi, based around a large telescope array and observatory. 
Added some new environment sounds for new area.
Fixed various terrain painting on Kiokio and Metarahi.
Fixed physical materials on some foliage assets.
Fixed placement of some foliage assets.

General

Added new cinema video handling. Direct youtube URLs are no longer supported, but instead any media can be linked directly. 
Added new 360 degree cinema at the newly added area.
Added steamworks inventory service support.
Added item store with several new clothing pattern packs available.
Added improvements to eye and skin materials.
Fixed an issue with unlocks for some flag pattern extras.

notes.title: Update 0.8.10.0
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/1222269a4ef4d45cb429eb84ecdb9f52bb60e879.jpg
For the past week we’ve been working on a new system to handle our open world streaming. We found our previous implementation of world composition wasn’t entirely flawless and some users would occasionally face hitches when crossing into new areas. With this update we have made this hitch free, so you can enjoy completely seamless loading. There is also a vastly increased render distance using improved LOD terrain to make the world better suited for the vehicles we are actively developing. 

The other significant change is repackaging of environment textures with the intention of providing more normal map detail, plus considerably reducing file size (the game is around 2 GB smaller installation size now). As part of quality improvements, all homes have had their available materials for customization adjusted, with previous not-so-good materials removed, and a bunch of new ones added. Most of the Shack house type materials have a grunge-layer added to better fit with the environment, plus we've improved the quality of shadows.

Additional changes in this update include much better LOD meshes for distant landscape, plus various fixes to foliage around Metarahi. We’ve also considerably increased the rendering distance of trees, so you will see them on distant islands. There are also some areas that have been tweaked slightly, like the caves on Naupata that have received better track and minecart models, plus the dock areas receiving various additional decor clutter.
	
Patch Notes:

Environment

Added foliage to several landscape tiles where there wasn’t previously.
Added new minecart and track models to Naupata caves.
Added various tweaks to foliage draw distances.
Added reworked texture packing for various normals to reduce artifacts. 
Added horse recall point near Matarangi (at base of hill, near bridge).
Added improved landscape lods.
Added landscape and environment texture file size reduction through revised packing (makes build size around  2GB less).
Added increased range of Metairangi Cinema.
Added additional props to Naupata docks.
Added improved shadows to all homes.
Fixed foliage placement on Metarahi, Kiokio and Naupata.
Fixed terrain painting on Metarahi, Kiokio and Naupata.
Fixed collisions of some objects on Metarahi.
Fixed rock placement on Naupata and Metarahi.

General

Added reworked selection of home wood materials for customization. This may break some previous customization saves (but will be fine when you make a new selection for the wood), as we have revised the selection. 
Added new Parquet flooring types of Bamboo, Makore and Walnut.
Added corrections to house coloration defaults.
Added reordering of spawn list slightly.
Fixed an issue with horse rider mounting.
Fixed an issue with options combo boxes for scalability not immediately updating.
Fixed various issues with home materials.
Fixed missing photos on Hawaiian house.
Fixed an issue with area volumes on Naupata.
Fixed various issues relating to server commands.

notes.title: Update 0.8.7.3
notes.content:
Following on from the update from a few days ago where we did considerable performance optimizations, we are now overhauling some of the visual quality of the game, adding some increased quality to the higher graphics settings while adding a couple more performance optimizations to the low ones. 

 Patch Notes:

Environment
Fixed various décor lacking physical materials (generates footsteps).
Fixed placement of certain décor at Wai Tai.
Fixed grass not appearing at Metairangi.
Fixed various terrain issues near Wai Tai.

General
Added improved shadow quality to Ultra and High settings. This takes advantage of shadow cascades which are slightly costlier, but we’ve done our best to optimize for performance. If you want to retain the shadows that were lower quality and solely based around distance fields as they were previously in ultra/high for more fps, then should now switch to medium for shadows specifically.
Added revised settings for anti-aliasing, Ultra is now higher quality, High remains the same, and both Medium and Low are lower quality settings than before for performance gains.
Fixed horse when walking not generating footstep sounds.
Fixed an issue with screen-space-reflections with foliage creating artifacts on water.
Fixed slider text entry selecting incorrect value range.
Fixed an issue where pressing quit in pause menu would produce a prompt behind the pause menu rarely.

notes.content:
This update we’ve done considerable optimizations to the game with the aum of increasing performance, plus we have re-attempted migration to 4.18 of UE4 after fixing various issues we had previously.

Environment

Added replacement to Distance-field ambient occlusion, which was bit costly and not fully compatible with everything we wanted to do. This should give a FPS boost to users who played in Ultra previously.
Added optimizations to rendering targets so GPU time should be down significantly, giving FPS boost to High and Ultra Quality Levels.
Added significant foliage optimizations which should give a small FPS boost on all quality levels.
Added audio attenuation (fading) for clubs and houses, plus overall increased audio quality.

Fixed climbing holds on Naupata not working correctly
Fixed various terrain painting on Naupata.
Fixed various rock placement on Nauapta.

Fixed various fish rising above water level in a few spots.
Fixed water-based audio not complying with options audio sliders.
Fixed various foliage LODs a little close

General

Added migration to UE4 4.18 version bringing improved audio streaming.
Added various optimizations to the way our HUD is handled, giving possible minor FPS boosts for low end users.
Added improvements to character skin material, to adapt better to revised lighting. 
Fixed various instances where player was able to enter movement states they shouldn’t have been able to at current position.
Fixed audio collision ranges on cinemas.

notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/818b41003c5747a3db14d58cc8fbc1d314b4e511.jpg

Time to head under the sea, with our latest significant update which includes a huge underwater expansion. Included are dense areas such as coral reefs, kelp forests and more, diversely populated with all kinds of marine life.

We suggest starting out at locations like Rawhiti or Tiata and diving down into the neighboring water channel to see some of the most densely populated areas. There are plans to continuously improve this underwater content and we welcome your feedback.

Additionally we have extended our localization support by a further 13 languages, bringing our total supported languages up to 27. So, whether you use Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Korean, Japanese, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Portuguese-Brazilian, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, or Ukrainian, you can use Capsa in your native localization :)  

Patch Notes:

Environment

Added underwater foliage which includes dense areas such as coral reefs and kelp forests.  For starters we’ve focused on the areas around Kiokio (notably the channel between Kiokio and Metarahi), but there will be greatly improved underwaters all around the map.
Added diverse selection of marine life, including many different fish, different species of shark, jelly fish, plankton, various turtles, eels and more. 
Added reworked post process and underwater effects.
Fixed terrain seam on Naupata.


General

Added 13 new localization's, including Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Finnish, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Romanian, Swedish, Thai, and Ukrainian. Please give feedback on any areas that need improving :)
Fixed horse sometimes sinking when entering the water (supposed to be able to swim!), it will now surface swim correctly (and not jump out water oddly either at times.

notes.title: Development Recap #1
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30701603/b5835b18f89d32f71346e1fdb1e0bcbe43ce6986.png

Throughout the month of November we added quite a few new features to Capsa, some as a result of great feedback from players. This is a short recap of the lasts months additions, as well as what to expect from the coming month. Please do continue to leave feedback and reviews, as this helps with development, as the more we know what you are thinking about our current progress, the better game we can make in the long run :)

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1230921503
Cinema
One of the first things we added was the Cinemas, at two locations; Tiata and Rawhiti. At each cinema users can play synchronized 1080p YouTube videos (which are also good for dancing too, in the case of music videos). Adding this was accelerated based on user feedback, and seems to be a well-used and great addition to the game.

We have plans to develop playlist support and a handful other expected features sometime after the New Year when we will revisit and improve this feature more.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1230919155
Climbing & Item Hunt
Based on the behavior of many of our users, we decided on adding climbing mechanics to the game. This involves hand-holds on cliff-faces and certain rocks, which users can use to reach new heights. We also added new climbing-based areas in all our existing areas.

Adding onto the climbing mechanics was the hidden item package hunting gameplay we added. For this we hid various colors of items in most of our designated areas, which currently around 90 in total to find. Each one unlocks an in-game usable title, which you can then pick via the character editor to sit under your player name.

There is likely room for improvement here with additional mechanics to add. We will also be adding more items to hunt for as we add new areas over time, as this proved popular with several players.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1230918585
Swimming
We didn't have this ready for our early access launch, but we finished it just recently, and included ability for the Horses to swim too. With swimming with your main character, you can dive down underwater where we will be adding underwater areas to explore in an upcoming update.

We want to give underwater areas the same attention to detail as on land so lots of exciting places to see, such as wreck sites and coral reefs, but more on that in upcoming updates, right now we just have purely the mechanical state to show off.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1230919217
Customizable Horses
We had horses in for launch, but only just made them customizable. You can pick from a handful of different colors, plus adjust the color of things like the mane and tail. We have plans to also added customization that effects things like what saddle and accessories your horse is wearing, this will be most likely coming in the new year.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1230916757
Steam Achievements
Since launch we’ve added more than 200 achievements that cover all aspects of Capsa. A lot of our users enjoyed collecting the initial batch we added, so we kept adding more based on everything new we added, and will continue to do so.

Another positive benefit to adding these achievements is that for areas or elements we specifically need testing get a lot more focus due to users collecting the achievements around them. They also help us collect useful statistics data on which activities people are doing the most, and this helps us orient development to certain areas, or consider why certain elements are underused and to improve upon them.

Upcoming Plans
Currently we are hard at work on three things, Bicycles, Underwater Content and Vive VR support. We hope to have all three out this month at current rate of development. We also hope to add additional language support, currently are supporting 14 localization's, but want to extend this further.

The underwater content will feature dense and detailed areas just like our on land areas. These will be constructed using the same base procedural, but then manual areas added to bring the areas to life. We aim to all kinds of different fishes and wildlife, with areas like kelp forests, coral reefs and more.

Meanwhile bicycles are in late development and in the process of being finished off. These will be fully customizable, with currently a dozen different slots for accessories and changes. We hope to show this off in the coming week.

And finally, VR support will begin with just Vive, but in the new year we will be looking to purchasing other headsets such as Oculus and get those supported if our implementation proves popular.

notes.title: Update 0.8.5.5
notes.content:
This update we've addressed the recent instability issues we encountered after migrating to 4.18 version of UE4. We have reverted the project back to 4.17 version of the engine, and got the vast majority of our content to work with that version. The net result is there should hopefully be no more disconnect issues, but big changes we recently added like the new water will still be included.

We will revisit the upgrade to new engine version after new year providing its all been patched and go through the process on a separate test branch till all issues are resolved. The audio streaming improvements were reliant on that version, and so will return then.

 Patch Notes:

General

Fixed various disconnect issues as a result of recent engine version migration by reverting to a previous version.

notes.title: Update 0.8.5.2
notes.content:
This is a large update that reworks our water implementation to add more visual effects (shore waves and underwater) plus adds swimming for both the main character and horse mount. We have also added two new types of Alice Bands, plus new outdoor furniture type for the homes. 

In this version we have also migrated the game to the latest 4.18 version of Unreal Engine from previous 4.17, and dealt with any incompatibilities or adjustments needed. 

Note: Early adopters of Capsa may not have the following keybinds mapped: “Crouch”, you can check this in the in-game control options (some may also have a conflict with Change Camera, and need to remap one or the other.

Patch Notes:

Clothing

Added Bunny Ears Alice Band

Environment

Added revised water system
Added waves to shoreline of Kiokio and part of Naupata (other areas will be updated over time)
Added revised underwater post-process effects
General

Added swimming mechanics for character (press Jump to swim up, and Crouch to dive down)
Added additional control for Crouch (crouch functionality not added yet)
Added swimming mechanics for horse (swims along surface only)
Added default controls change, C is now Crouch and V is now Camera, this will not affect existing control setups, only new users.
Added stats tracking distance and time spent swimming.
Added achievements for swimming and added swimming stats.
Added in-game titles for some new achievements. 
Added an additional outdoor furniture type for homes.
Fixed an issue where music wouldn’t stop playing when leaving home audio volumes. (Related to 4.18 Migration).
Fixed an issue where radial menu graphics didn’t appear to line up when interacted with mouse (related to 4.18 Migration).
Fixed horses not recalling customization during initial spawn in singleplayer.
Fixed horses not retaining customization when you go to respawn a horse for a second time after customizing it the first time after initial spawn in multiplayer.
Fixed horse spawner not hiding with hide hud option.
Fixed some sliders not able to reach 0.
Fixed tiling rates on various wood flooring.

Please let us know of any problems you encounter, as due to the size of this update, there is always the possibility of issues. If you make us aware of them we can hotfix them asap :)

notes.title: Update 0.8.5.0
notes.content:
In this update we’ve been looking into control improvements as well as lots of other quality of life changes. There are also various fixes to things reported to us over the last few days :)

Patch Notes:

General

Added more control sets, so you can configure upcoming vehicles independently of character.
Added in-game mouse y-axis and x-axis inversion for camera only. 
Added in-game mouse camera sensitivity option .
Added in-game gamepad camera sensitivity option.
Added in-game gamepad y-axis and x-axis inversion for camera only.
Added walk/run mode option, allows you to choose whether have to hold or toggle key
Added mouse acceleration option, with slider to control amount of acceleration
Added scroll bars to all option menu pages to fit added settings
Added field of view camera adjustment option
Added various slider optimizations
Added various improvements to game UI in steps towards multi-monitor support (still various in-game camera adjustments to be made and few UI tweaks before full support)
Added graphics option to pad the HUD where you want to force it to sit on a specific screen. Options include to pad both left and right (so it sits on middle screen for 3 monitors), or either left or right, if you have a dual monitor setup.
Added various back-end optimizations to input handling, allowing for more input sets but reusing existing functions
Added additional toggle to hideshowhud so it now rotates between hiding your own name, hiding all names, or showing all.
Added control to toggle between names and Steam Account ID’s on HUD and in chat so you can see who someone actually is. 
Added function so that when you click on a users steam id in chat it takes you to their profile rather than message them in a whisper.
Added improvements to hideshowhud so its state remains when boarding a vehicle.
Added redundancy for stopping audio from YouTube videos.
Fixed loading screen for non widescreen resolutions.
Fixed main menu for small non-widecreen resolutions.
Fixed some scroll bars to work with custom menu theme color.
Fixed an issue where mounting a horse while inside a video or musing playing radius would not stop the audio when leaving.
Fixed some control remapping not referenced correctly.
Fixed vehicle or mount dismounting where if area is not available to dismount after a few attempts it will revert to rider state.
Fixed male makeup not applying.
Fixed some social information not replicating reliably.
Fixed area indicator not changing when riding horse.
Fixed sound volumes not triggering when riding horse.

notes.title: Update 0.8.4.4
notes.content:
Today's update is a few quality of life changes, we've added a couple extra server configuration options and adjusted clubs, homes and few other areas to be vehicle free where needed via blocking volumes. Please let us know of any outstanding issues you find :)

Patch Notes:

Environment

Fixed various terrain smoothing on Naupata east.


General

Added blocking volumes for vehicles/mounts at all clubs, cinemas, and some other areas. This prevents interfering on dance floors by filling up with horses etc. or completing certain puzzles easily.
Added blocking volumes for vehicles/mounts for all homes, this will cover under-roof areas, so you simply can’t ride a horse inside the house, but can park it just outside still.
Added ability for server admins to block / ban users joining a server. To do this in the server config “BannedSteamID=” you can add multiple by separating with a comma. 
Added optimizations to gametags, allowing support for more server data to be shared.
Added optional gametag for server country code, so a flag is displayed on the server browser. To do this in server config “CountryCode=” with entering the 2 letter ISO-3166 country code. This should help keep the server browser clutter free rather than people listing their servers country in the name. 


The tools to block users will improve over the coming week or so, as-well as in-game mechanisms to remove users and check their SteamID's in easy fashion. While its not really an issue right now thankfully for the most part, we want these systems in place for when it might be down the road :)

notes.title: Update 0.8.3.0
notes.content:
This update includes a big update to the homes system that allows more extensive customization. We’ve added support to customize all the non-painted parts, plus gone through and optimized the applier system in general. We have also added a system for changing which sit animation you use when sitting on chairs, and addressed various issues mentioned to us over the last couple days.

Patch Notes:

Environment

Added hitching post at Puna Manawa
Fixed spawn point at Matapari too far from hitching post
Fixed texturing on Tropical Shack, where some small parts on wall weren’t correct color
Fixed all homes to work with applier updates
Fixed various issues on Surf Shack and Tropical Shack
Fixed collision on Hawaiian House steps
Fixed a server configuration issue not reading correct day length
Fixed various chair sit positions
Fixed LODs on Small Palms which were a little close
Fixed spawned furniture placement on Tropical Shack
Fixed various house placements on Naupata
Fixed various foliage placements on Naupata

General

Added more customization to homes, you can now choose things like the different type of wood material for non-painted parts. This involves stuff like decking,  frame/supports or wood flooring.
Added support for further customization of homes by extending maximum pattern layers to 7
Added various optimizations to home editor code which may see minor performance gains during saving process. (for most users this was already virtually instantaneous)
Added various optimizations to home applier code which may see minor performance gains during local applying (applying while editor is open, and not final save).
Added support for different furniture layout options (actual options will be in later update)
Added reset to 0 mechanism for single element if an element for home customization is not found in users save-game due to additions or new feature.
Added new achievements.
Added new titles to correspond to recently added achievements
Added radial interface for choosing chair sits (press F or gamepad Y when sat down)
Fixed title previous select button not working
Fixed a stat based achievement not tracking time
Fixed stick that holds up shutters not applying customization
Fixed lamp not turning on at night inside home
Fixed an issue where ground-sits animation were not updating for other players
Fixed an issue where clicking a blank space on radial menu wouldn’t exit menu
Fixed an issue where couldn’t customize frames and door on San Diego and San Francisco
Fixed audio range on the Tropical Cottage and Hawaiian homes being too close

notes.title: Update 0.8.2.2
notes.content:
We have introduced achievements, area population statistics and area-based chat, while continuing to address any reported issues and improve overall user experience. 

Patch Notes:

Clothing

Added Earrings for male and female including round, heart, star, hoops, pumpkin and bat.


Environment

Added a larger house type to both kiokio and metarahi. This home has lots of room for dancing, and more space for guests to come sit at.
Added a work-in-progress horse racing track to kio-kio, not currently functional, but can be played on.
Adjusted foliage around Kiokio ri te rawhiti.
Fixed ‘glowing green light’ at Ahi Tere, and other areas. 
Added spawn point to the cinema on Kiokio as well as added spawn-points at 2 hidden locations.
Adjusted seating at Cinema on kiokio
Added decorative lighting at Cinema on kiokio
Fixed alignment of various meshes
Renamed Kiokio ri te rawhiti to rawhiti.
Re-simulated Metarahi’s foliage to clear up any problematic placements.
Fixed LODs on furniture at clubs and cinema


General

Added achievements, this first batch just for visiting each area on Kiokio
Certain spawn points are now locked until discovered for the first time (club and cinema available from start).
Added key alias so Action menu can be opened with both F and 5 keys. (Users without a qwerty keyboard may only be able to use F key)
Added alias for zoom, which can now be performed using scroll wheel.
Added aliases for run and walk, which can be now performed using the right shift and ctrl keys.
Added aliases for in-game menu, which can be also opened with f10.
Added area population statistic system. This shows a breakdown of players per area when you look at the spawn menu including from the main menu.
Added area chat, which can be accessed by “/2” or “/area”. This will chat to everyone who is in the same area (noted in lower right of screen) as you. This will be good to talk specifically to the club or cinema you are at.
Fixed an issue with reverting to third person camera when sitting, camera is now correct distance away and you can see yourself properly, without having to move.
 

New-player experience Improvements

Added population count to spawns when visible from main menu, plus, spawns will be ordered by current population, to ensure new players always end up where people are at – e.g. the dance club or cinema everyone may be at. This should also help negate the need to ask where people are.
Initial spawn points reduced (with most unlockable within an hour or so of exploration gameplay) will help direct first time users to popular social hubs, rather than remote locations.


We will be adding more achievements very soon, and will also be looking to get both Steam stats and trading cards in over the next couple weeks. Please let us know if encounter any issues :)

notes.title: Update 0.8.2.1
notes.content:
Small update continuing to target improving the experience of new users, while fixing any outstanding launch issues. There are however a few content additions, including now functional cinema. 

Patch Notes:

Clothing

Added polka pattern on female spandex shorts.
Reworked materials on a few more clothing pieces.
Fixed Female T-shirt Stripes pattern to accept correct number of colors.

Environment

Made cinema added at kiokio ri ti rawiti yesterday functional.
Changed the spawn location at Ahi Tere.
Fixed various issues near Kiokio ri ti rawiti.
Fixed various issues near Ahi Tere.
Made changes to various pathways between kiokio ri ti rawiti and matapari based on observed traffic flow. 
Added additional horse hitching posts to various locations.

General

Added mouse control to radial menu.
Changed radial menu to open with “F” key instead of “5” for keyboards due to issues on some non-QWERTY keyboards (remappable keys coming soon :P)
Fixed an issue where certain claims and overlaps were triggered on horseback.
Added redundancy so that music will attempt to 5 play times after a short delay before timing out when entering a club area, to avoid chance of it not running. 
Fixed mounting range when getting off a horse.
Added “/unclaim” command to unown your home or area you have control of. You can specify which with “/unclaim 1” being club/cinema and “/unclaim 2” being home. “/unclaim” on its own will do both.

New-player experience Improvements

Moved some spawn areas so that users are closer to popular hang out locations.
Overhauled default character spawn, so players will always start with a random preset to remove the whole “new player” look at spawn areas.
Made the radial menu usable for keyboard/mouse users, so can simply tell people to press F if they cannot customize character, sit, dance and so on. Existing keys and chat commands will remain, which may be favorable to some users.

notes.title: Update 0.8.2.0
notes.content:
Small content update this week while we’ve been addressing any outstanding issues, we’ve been taking in lots of feedback and have made a few changes to ideally improve the experience of first time users :)

Patch Notes:

Clothing

Added female swimsuit.
Added Male and Female Long-Sleeve T-shirt.
Added stripe pattern design to both t-shirt and long-sleeve t-shirt.
Added stripe pattern to board-shorts.
Added polka pattern and stripe pattern to female bikini, thin bikini, and sports bottoms.
Added different animal-face patterns to female thin bikini.
Reworked base material on several clothing pieces.

Environment

Added work-in-progress cinema area south of the area of Kiokio ri ti rawiti, not currently functional, but will be this week :)
Added houses north and south of the area of Ahi Tere.
Added houses south of the area of Kiokio ri ti rawiti.
Added various torches and lighting around Nauapta pathways.
Fixed furniture on Naupata which could not be interacted with.
Fixed floating objects that were reported.

General

Fixed a few translations that didn’t fit the UI space
Fixed “test” string that would appear for a few milliseconds below a players name on spawning.

New-player experience Improvements

Re-arranged the spawn list to make it easier for new players to find current popular destinations.
Make mounting a horse automatic when spawning it (In future an optional setting will be added to disable this behavior, this is just a quick fix to aid those who can’t figure it out when they first join.) 
Made global chat the default channel (for now at least).
Increased say chat range slightly ~25m.

We will be in-game and watching the forums for feedback, right now we are focusing on improving the initial experience of the game, so new players find it easier to get into as well as fixing any outstanding bugs or issues we are aware of. There will be an update likely in the next day or two, and more significant content updates coming next month which we will be talking about soon :)

If want to meet us in-game, we are typically online in “Carly’s Server” between hours of 18:00 and 02:00 UTC.

notes.title: Update 0.8.1.8
notes.content:
We've just posted another hot-fix to solve any remaining launch-day feedback we've received.

Patch Notes

Fixed an issue with horse not despawning when leaving server
Fixed an issue where you could press E from anywhere and mount your horse
Fixed an issue where some users were not hearing sounds walking along the paths
Added more horse spawn points around the island of Kio Kio
Fixed " has left the game" messages not being received.
 
If you are experiencing another issue do let us know :)

notes.title: Update 0.8.1.7
notes.content:
We’ve just posted a quick hot-fix to solve a few issues players have found in the last few hours after launch.

Patch Notes

    Fixed an issue with incorrect player names displayed in chat on populated servers
    Fixed an issue where some users couldn’t dance or use an emote via the chat commands.
 

Known Issues

Some users have reported not being able to hear sound when walking, we are looking into this.
Horses may on occasion not be deleted correctly when leaving server, a fix for this will come soon.
 

If you are experiencing another issue do let us know :) We’ll probably have another hotfix over the next 24 hours as we fix the things that will take us a little longer.
